content:
Apple TV today released the first footage from the second season of German dark comedy "Where's Wanda?" and confirmed the return date. Details below.

"Where's Wanda?" returns October 21

"Where's Wanda?" didn't make much of a splash when it premiered in 2024, but was quickly hailed as a fun and wicked hidden gem on Apple TV.

The series follows the Klatt family, who, frustrated by the lack of progress in the police investigation, decide to take matters into their own hands to find their missing daughter.

Nearly two years after the nine-episode first season wrapped, Apple TV has finally confirmed the show will return on October 21, and has released the first footage from the new season.

Apple TV also released the synopsis for season two of "Where's Wanda?", but it contains spoilers, so please finish watching the first season before continuing:

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can subscribe via the Apple One bundle. The platform includes many popular series and movies, including "Severance," "The Studio," "The Morning Show," "Shrinking," and "Silo."
